# NASA POWER Data Attribution

These data were obtained from the [NASA Langley Research Center (LaRC) POWER Project](https://power.larc.nasa.gov/) funded through the NASA Earth Science/Applied Science Program.

- **Primary Source**: NASA Modern-Era Retrospective analysis for Research and Applications, Version 2 (MERRA-2) and Goddard Earth Observing System (GEOS) data assimilation models.
- **Citation**: NASA POWER Project, NASA Langley Research Center, Hampton, VA, USA.
- **Access**: Free public open-access for research, commercial, and operational use.
